frozen_body: W01 identifies the common complexification of Euclidean, Minkowski, and split-signature four-vector spaces with M(2,C)=Hom(S_R,S_L), while retaining different real-form/action constraints for each signature.
semantic_guards: All three real forms share the same qualified complex M2(C) carrier but remain distinct subcarriers/action constraints.
The split signature is represented by an explicit real basis and exact quadratic form, not a role label.
The split two-factor action is a restriction of the qualified complex action and preserves the exact split quadratic form.
No real forms are collapsed into each other.
No Lisi or cross-track semantics are used.
